description: Metrics 2.5.1 Slice G — local KRX trading-calendar fixture (evidence, not a live service).
timezone: Asia/Seoul (KRX); adapter is date-string based and never calls now()/today() or a network service.
note: Trading days = weekdays in [start,end] minus holidays. 2026-07-16 (Thu) is a synthetic market holiday so 2026-07-17 (Fri) previous trading day is 2026-07-15 (Wed). 2026-07-01 is the first trading day so it has no previous market day. Weekends: 2026-07-18 (Sat), 2026-07-19 (Sun).
